teaser: "You always figure it out, somehow." Someone says this to you, handing off a problem as if it were a compliment. Life path 4 is the builder, laying floor after floor of a life meant to hold weight; ENFJ is the teacher, the one who sees what a room could become and starts rearranging chairs toward it. Crossed, the two share a stubborn faith in effort — that steady hands and the right word can hold almost anything together. What's particular here is the weight: a structure built for others to stand on, by someone also trying to charm everyone into liking where they're standing.
